name: packman
description: Script runners and dependency intelligence right inside your package.json.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces Packman shows its Overlay but does not offer to run scripts.

packman.github.token.markdownDescription: Optional GitHub token for Dependency issue counts. When empty, Packman uses the GitHub account signed in to the editor (Accounts menu). Without either, GitHub allows 60 requests/hour per IP — one package.json can exhaust that, and issue counts pause until the window resets. A token or signed-in account raises the limit to 5,000/hour. Public repo metadata needs no scopes.

packman.socket.apiToken.markdownDescription: Socket.org API token (end-user). Required together with `#packman.socket.orgSlug#` to show Socket scores on Dependencies.

packman.socket.orgSlug.markdownDescription: Socket organization slug for `POST /orgs/{org}/purl`. Required together with `#packman.socket.apiToken#`.

packman.overlay.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the Packman Overlay in the `package.json` text editor: ▶ Run (or Trust workspace) actions on scripts, latest-version and Socket signals on each Dependency, hovers with GitHub details fetched on hover, and per-block summaries with Refresh. `Packman: Toggle Overlay` hides or shows it for the current session.
